policy: Additive only: a correction may add an accepted value for a field whose truth status is 'present'. It may not change a status, remove an accepted value, change a declared scenario or expected comparison, or touch any threshold. Results scored with corrections are reported beside, never in place of, results under the original truth.

corrections.adjudicated: 2026-10-22, during SPIKE-1B.2, before the pass-2 model run
corrections.rationale: The rendered screenshot prints the plan in two places: the labelled field 'Current plan: Standard' (bold) and the payment row description 'Standard plan'. Both name the same product; 'plan' is a generic word, not part of the plan name. The original truth accepted only the row wording, so a faithful reading of the labelled plan field was scored wrong_value. The expected comparison (declared plan 'Standard' -> consistent) was already correct and is unchanged.
